[RDSC.4c.1] The `CompiledCode` atom carries compiled machine code for a single
Rete node (one `AlphaNode` alpha test, one `BetaNode` join test, or one `TerminalNode` RHS).
The body contains a fixed-layout slot table of external function
pointer slots (zero-filled in the file, and filled at load time by a runtime
that executes the code; in this edition none does, [RDSC.4c.3]) followed by
position-independent machine code.
